description: pnpm 12 refuses to install a package published less than a day ago (its default minimumReleaseAge), so a PR opened sooner fails every install. Wait the same day, and open no branch until it has passed.

packageRules.description: Core and CLI are released together, and `pnpm theme:build` stamps both versions into the generated theme, so they update in one PR.
@astrojs/cloudflare pulls in @cloudflare/vite-plugin, which can need a newer wrangler than the lockfile holds, so wrangler moves with Astro.
